method: Independent source and existing receipt review. No test, build, browser, or release process launched by this lane.

evidence: Installed node_modules/vitest/package.json is 4.1.11; svg-caption-red-001 and svg-caption-green-001 logs show actual Vitest v4.1.11 executing with --maxWorkers=1.
release.sh's mandatory unit-tests row invokes pnpm -s exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1. Resource-policy allowlist, resource guard filtered-test prefix, and release fixture now agree on that command.

The resource guard's memory, CPU, disk, swap, process ownership, and exact-command admission logic is unchanged by cb6b85e6. Removing unsupported --minWorkers=1 does not expand worker count because --maxWorkers=1 remains required.
a_vitest4_release_repair.runtime_limit: The scoped receipts execute the filtered scrape suite, not a full release.sh run. This review therefore confirms the actual Vitest 4 invocation and source wiring, but does not claim every mandatory release check completed.
a_vitest4_release_repair.followup: Run the full guarded release check path on the current commit and retain a receipt showing the unit-tests row reached actual Vitest 4.1.11 and completed.

evidence: svg-caption-red-001 records the actual runScrape/Defuddle test failing on the missing caption while the SVG image assertion had already passed: 1 failed, 14 passed.
svg-caption-green-001 records Vitest 4.1.11 passing the same suite on the changed source: 15 passed.

The repair replaces each protected SVG image in place with its token, then moves every child node of its enclosing figure to the figure's position. For one ordinary SVG figure this retains the caption and HTML sibling nodes for Defuddle in DOM order.
Earlier SVG suite cases still cover one standalone figure and one composite multi-SVG figure. The new caption case confirms caption and label presence through runScrape, DOMPurify, and Turndown.
b_svg_caption_repair.coverage_gap: The new test contains one figure and one protected SVG image, and its three toContain assertions do not assert relative order. No recorded run proves two captioned figures, SVG plus ordinary image siblings, or multi-SVG composite plus caption through final Markdown. Source iteration handles those cases plausibly, but this review cannot certify the full all-figures-and-order acceptance from the available evidence.
concrete_followup_cases: Two separate inline-SVG figures, each with a distinct figcaption and HTML label, with normal paragraphs between: assert exactly two SVG data images and the complete interleaved Markdown order.
One figure with a composite two-or-more-SVG graphic, a caption, and an HTML label: assert one complete composite image followed by both distinct text nodes in source order.

One SVG figure with an ordinary img sibling and its caption, plus a separate ordinary non-SVG article: assert the ordinary image is retained and ordinary article extraction has no new image or text duplication.
b_svg_caption_repair.ui_gap: No independent extension UI capture or copy check on a real or clearly labeled owned local captioned article is recorded. The existing Mathspace reference establishes composite SVG handling, not caption preservation.

acceptance_position: Do not mark full remote-stack acceptance verified until the full release receipt, ordered multi-figure pipeline cases, and independent extension UI check are complete.
